verdict.rationale: Scoped credentials are a fair question for a terminal emulator, since a terminal could ship a remote-control interface with permission-restricted access for agents. The evidence shows Ghostty has no such API. The runtime probe found no remote-control or IPC interface, and the probes for an OpenAPI spec all returned 404. Secure Keyboard Entry and AppleScript are adjacent features, not credential issuance, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
